position.mechanism: codex/hooks/task_state.py, read by the Guard in the governed profile
position.note: Wired in source for the governed profile only; light and standard do not use the phase. Not promoted or probed yet.

restrict.note: Covers structured read, write, and delete calls. Write targets inside shell commands are not parsed. The guard_fault rule is verified on the installed Guard file under the registered interpreter, not by a live fault inside the host.

empower.mechanism: codex/bin/codex-task (profile, declare, revoke), read by the Guard in the governed profile
empower.note: An agent tool cannot edit a declaration, but an agent shell can run codex-task itself: in this host Empower leaves an audit trail and is not a hard boundary.

contain.mechanism: workspace root, temp directories, and extra_write_roots in codex/runtime/harness-scope.json, read by the Guard in the governed profile
contain.note: The always-protected set (harness install, credentials, OS persistence) is enforced through Restrict in every profile.

restrict.note: No adapter yet (SHI-627). Repository hooks do not apply in project cloud threads per the Claude Code settings documentation read on 2026-11-26; not probed.
